capabilities: Track job applications across pipeline stages on a drag-and-drop Kanban board
Manage recruiters, hiring managers, and other contacts per application
Schedule multi-round interviews and generate prep and debrief notes from templates
Attach and embed job description PDFs or Markdown files in collapsible callouts
Visualize pipeline metrics with KPI cards, stage breakdowns, and an SVG Sankey diagram
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a job search pipeline, interview rounds, and recruiting contacts across notes.

relations.evidence: fully compatible with Obsidian Search, Dataview, and graph view

summary: Job search tracker that manages applications, contacts, and interview rounds with Kanban, table, list, and Sankey analytics dashboards.
